infoAllowIdleAbovePauseLabel: Toggle info for Allow Idle Above Pause
infoPrioritizeIdleModeLabel: Toggle info for Prioritize Idle Mode
takesEffectWithSwitch: Takes effect once a charging switch is selected.
testDurationNotice: This process takes 5-10 minutes. Do not close the WebUI.
bannerDetectingSwitch: Detecting a charging switch... ACC is testing switches in the background, so charging may pause briefly.
bannerDaemonStoppedNoSwitch: No charging switch selected and the daemon is stopped. Start it so ACC can detect one, or run Test All.
bannerSelectSwitch: No charging switch selected. Pick a working switch, or plug in a charger and let ACC detect one.
bannerChargerConnected: Charger connected. ACC will look for a charging switch as soon as the battery is charging.
bannerNoSwitchFound: No charging switch found. Plug in a charger so ACC can automatically detect a working switch.
bannerRestartRequired: Daemon restart required to apply changes.
noChargerForTestAll: No charger connected. Plug in a charger to run Test All.
confirmResetConfig: The entire config will be reset. Proceed?
descriptionCurrentSwitch: Displays the sysfs node currently controlling your battery's charging state. If this field is blank or fails, click Test All to find a compatible switch. Then set a switch with either the dropdown or the manual override input below.
descriptionWorkingSwitches: Switches that ACC successfully detected and verified as functional on your device. [I] switches support true Battery Idle Mode (powering the phone directly from the wall charger without charging the battery). [D] switches only disable power input. If you only see a single selection, click Test All to populate all working switches.
descriptionManualOverride: Set a custom kernel path if your switch is not detected. Appending " --" to a valid path locks it and disables ACC's 3-strike fallback cycle. If a switch path is invalid or fails execution completely, ACC will revert to its database to restore charging control.
descriptionForceOff: Aggressively enforces charging switch states to prevent rogue system thermal daemons (e.g., mi_thermald) from overriding ACC's charging switch. Only needed if your switch is being reset constantly by the system.
descriptionOnPause: Resets battery statistics whenever charging reaches the pause threshold.
descriptionOnUnplug: Resets battery statistics whenever the charger is unplugged.
descriptionOnPlug: Resets battery statistics whenever the charger is plugged in.
descriptionAllowIdleAbovePause: When disabled, ACC avoids idle mode if battery capacity is above the pause threshold to prevent keeping the battery highly charged for extended periods.
descriptionPrioritizeIdleMode: Gives precedence to charging switches that support battery idle mode (powering the device directly off the charger without charging the battery).
descriptionOffMid: Turns charging off automatically when ACC starts and the battery capacity is between the resume and pause thresholds.
descriptionIdleApps: Matches Android app package names. When a matched app is running in the foreground, ACC automatically enables idle mode. Idle mode is not triggered in split-screen unless both visible apps match the list, and it does not trigger when the app is running in the background.
